data.narrative:
Precision AI is a Series A–stage autonomous systems company founded by Daniel McCann, having raised $20M to date. The broader Drones & Autonomous sector includes 8 private peer companies—among them Zipline, Joby Aviation, Nuro, Archer Aviation, and Elroy Air—and no directly comparable public benchmarks. The narrow peer set (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier within this sector) contains fewer than three datapoints, limiting peer-median triangulation.

Given data constraints, valuation relies on stage-progression methodology. Using total capital raised of $20M as a proxy base value and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of $40M. This method is the only reliably applicable triangulation approach given the sparsity of narrow-stage comparables in the autonomous systems space.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $34M (low) to $46M (high), with a median of $40M. Key uncertainties include the absence of granular same-stage private comps with disclosed terms, the lack of public market reference points, and the nascent nature of autonomous delivery and drone regulation, which may influence growth trajectory assumptions embedded in typical stage-step multipliers. Revenue traction, capital efficiency, and technical differentiation would be critical to validating positioning within this range.
